question.zh: 做技术视频(YouTube、课程视频)时,形式、选题和制作流程怎么取舍?
question.en: When making technical videos (YouTube, course videos), how do you weigh format, topic and production?

claim.text.zh: 技术视频要在「技巧够酷」「每一步准确」「有趣简洁」之间做取舍,三者只能选两个;形式上可以用低成本的一镜到底提高频率,把重要内容切成小段精心录制;他还持续用自建工具(边录边剪的编辑器、AI 预演)降低制作成本。
claim.text.en: A technical video can have a cool technique, accuracy at every step, or a fun, concise delivery. Pick two. Use inexpensive one-take recordings to publish often; record important material carefully in small pieces. Reduce production work with tools such as an editor that cuts as you record and AI previews.

steps.0.title.zh: 先决定这条视频要哪两样
steps.0.title.en: First decide which two this video gets

steps.0.how.zh: 技巧、准确、娱乐三者难以兼得。做教程就优先准确和步骤完整;做快讯或观点就优先有趣和简洁。先定取舍,再定长度和剪辑方式。
steps.0.how.en: Technique, accuracy and entertainment are hard to get together. A tutorial puts accuracy and complete steps first; a news item or opinion puts fun and brevity first. Decide the trade-off before the length and the editing.

steps.1.title.zh: 选题:一条一个主题,讲新动态或新心智模型
steps.1.title.en: Topics: one topic per video, news or a new mental model

steps.1.how.zh: 一条视频只讲一个主题:他把原本的一条长视频按依赖图拆成多条短视频,发现更能留住观众、也更利于搜索。他还观察到「新闻式」视频和能给出新心智模型的讲解视频反响最好:报道 TS 社区的新动态,或者把一个常见主题换个角度讲透。
steps.1.how.en: One video covers one topic: he split one long video along its dependency graph into several short ones and found they held viewers better and did better in search. He also saw that news-style videos and explanations that give a new mental model do best: reporting what is new in the TS community, or taking a common topic from a new angle and explaining it fully.

steps.2.title.zh: 两种节奏:低成本一镜到底,和分段精录
steps.2.title.en: Two rhythms: a cheap single take, and careful pieces

steps.2.how.zh: 日常内容可以一镜到底、不剪辑,十分钟做完,保持频率(他后来专门开了一个发原始内容的副频道);重要内容(如会议演讲)切成小段逐段录好再拼起来。
steps.2.how.en: Everyday content can be one take with no editing, done in ten minutes, to keep up the frequency (he later started a second channel just for raw content); important material (such as a conference talk) is cut into short pieces, each recorded well and then joined.

steps.3.title.zh: 缩略图当作产品的一部分来练
steps.3.title.en: Practise thumbnails as part of the product

steps.3.how.zh: 缩略图决定点击。他会在设计工具里模拟 YouTube 页面,把缩略图放在真实环境里比较。
steps.3.how.en: Thumbnails decide clicks. He mocks up a YouTube page in a design tool and compares thumbnails in a realistic setting.

steps.4.title.zh: 用工具降低制作成本:边录边剪、AI 预演
steps.4.title.en: Use tools to cut production cost: edit while recording, AI previews

steps.4.how.zh: 他自建了视频编辑器:录制时按说话自动切片并转写,可以边录边删;2026 年又让 AI 根据课程内容生成带配音的预演版(animatic),在正式拍摄前检查节奏和画面。
steps.4.how.en: He built his own video editor that slices and transcribes by speech as you record, so you can delete as you go. In 2026 he also had AI generate a voiced preview (an animatic) from course content, to check pacing and visuals before the real shoot.

pitfalls.0.text.zh: 想一条视频同时做到又酷、又完整准确、又短又有趣。
pitfalls.0.text.en: Trying to make one video cool, complete and accurate, and short and fun all at once.

pitfalls.1.text.zh: 标题党缩略图:他承认偶尔用,但要内容配得上。
pitfalls.1.text.en: Clickbait thumbnails: he admits to using them now and then, but the content has to live up to them.

evolution.0.stance.zh: 把 Twitter 上的 TS 技巧整理成 YouTube 播放列表;发现「新闻式」视频受欢迎;练缩略图。
evolution.0.stance.en: He gathers his Twitter TS tips into YouTube playlists, finds news-style videos popular, and practises thumbnails.

evolution.1.stance.zh: 总结三选二;尝试一镜到底的低成本形式;演讲分段精录。
evolution.1.stance.en: He sums up the pick-two rule, tries a cheap one-take format, and records talks in carefully made pieces.

evolution.2.stance.zh: 自建边录边剪的编辑器;开副频道发原始内容;用 AI 生成视频预演。
evolution.2.stance.en: He builds an editor that cuts while recording, starts a second channel for raw content, and uses AI to generate video previews.
